note: Both sets cover the same core facts (filter type, corner frequency 0.25 Hz at the -3 dB point, 0.0125 s time step) and both contain duplicated claims and one unsupported value of -80 deg at 1.00 Hz whose own quote reads -75. Set A binds the 1.00 Hz readings (-75 deg phase, -12 dB magnitude) to quotes that actually name those values, whereas Set B attaches only the figure caption to those claims and adds a -72 deg phase claim contradicted by its own quote of -75. Set A also carries a -12.5 dB claim contradicted by its quote of -12, so it is not clean, but it has fewer misread values than Set B.
